Compute one-step CellTFusion

CellTFusion.Rd

Runs the full CellTFusion pipeline in a single call: cell-type deconvolution, TF activity inference, TF module construction, pathway activity, cell group construction, NMF latent factors and cell niches.

Usage

CellTFusion(
  raw_counts,
  deconv = NULL,
  dt = NULL,
  tfs = NULL,
  pathways = NULL,
  normalized = TRUE,
  batch = NULL,
  deconv_methods = c("Quantiseq", "CBSX", "Epidish", "DeconRNASeq", "DWLS"),
  cbsx_mail = NULL,
  cbsx_token = NULL,
  do_parallel = FALSE,
  workers = NULL,
  file_name = NULL,
  TF.collection = "CollecTRI",
  method = "ulm",
  min_targets_size = 5,
  universe = NULL,
  paths = NULL,
  gene_sets = NULL,
  min_module_size = 5,
  corr_mod = 0.9,
  soft_power = NULL,
  consensus_quantile = 0,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  corr = 0.7,
  corr_type = "spearman",
  cells_extra = NULL,
  pval = 0.05,
  padj = FALSE,
  min_cluster_size = 3,
  compute_factors = TRUE,
  top_n = 5,
  cancer_type = NULL,
  return = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

Arguments

raw_counts

A matrix of raw gene expression counts (genes as rows, samples as columns). If normalized = FALSE, a matrix of TPM-normalized values instead (not log-transformed). Always required, also when dt, tfs and pathways are all supplied precomputed (its samples are checked against them).

deconv

(Optional) A data frame with deconvolution features (cell-type proportions as columns x samples as rows). If NULL (default), it is computed with multideconv::compute.deconvolution() using deconv_methods. Ignored if dt is supplied.

dt

(Optional) A precomputed cell-subgroup object, typically the output of multideconv::compute.deconvolution.analysis() (or the Processed_deconvolution element returned by a previous CellTFusion() run). If supplied, cell-type deconvolution and the deconvolution analysis step are both skipped and the pipeline proceeds straight to cell group construction using this object. It must have the same samples as raw_counts.

tfs

(Optional) A precomputed TF activity matrix (samples as rows, TFs as columns), typically the TFs_matrix element returned by a previous CellTFusion() run or by compute.TFs.activity(). When batch is given, a named list of such matrices (one per cohort). If supplied, TF activity inference is skipped.

pathways

(Optional) A precomputed pathway activity matrix, typically the Pathways_scores element returned by a previous CellTFusion() run or by compute.pathway.activity(). If supplied, pathway activity inference is skipped.

normalized

Logical; if TRUE (default), raw_counts are raw counts and are normalized to log2(TPM + 1) for the TF activity and pathway activity steps (for deconvolution they are normalized to TPM only). If FALSE, raw_counts must already be TPM-normalized and not log-transformed: the TPM values are used as they are for deconvolution and log2(TPM + 1) is computed internally for the other steps. Do not pass log-transformed values, as they would be log-transformed a second time (a warning is given when the values do not look like TPM, i.e. no value above 20 or negative values).

batch

(Optional) A vector with the cohort of each sample (e.g. coldata$Cohort), in the same order as the columns of raw_counts; if it is named, it is matched to the samples by name instead. It is always treated as categorical. If given, the multi-cohort mode is run: TF and pathway activities are computed per cohort, TF modules are built from a consensus network across cohorts (see consensus_quantile), and the cohort is controlled for in the deconvolution analysis and cell group construction. Default is NULL (single cohort); a vector with only one cohort is treated the same way.

deconv_methods

A character vector of deconvolution methods to apply. Default is c("Quantiseq", "CBSX", "Epidish", "DeconRNASeq", "DWLS"). "CBSX" (CIBERSORTx) is only run when cbsx_mail and cbsx_token are given; otherwise it is skipped with a message.

cbsx_mail

(Optional) Email credential for CIBERSORTx. Needed to run "CBSX"; without it, CIBERSORTx is skipped.

cbsx_token

(Optional) Token credential for CIBERSORTx. Needed to run "CBSX"; without it, CIBERSORTx is skipped.

do_parallel

Logical; whether to run the deconvolution methods that support it (CIBERSORTx and DWLS) in parallel, one signature per worker (passed to multideconv::compute.deconvolution() as doParallel). Default is FALSE.

workers

(Optional) Number of parallel workers when do_parallel = TRUE. If NULL (default), the number of available cores minus one is used.

file_name

(Optional) Name used in the output files saved in the "Results/" directory. If NULL and return = TRUE, "CellTFusion" is used.

TF.collection

Character. The source of the TF-target network. Options are "CollecTRI" (default), "Dorothea", or "ARACNE".

  • "CollecTRI" uses the prebuilt collection from OmnipathR and "Dorothea" the one from the dorothea package.

  • "ARACNE" reads a network file (tab-separated with Regulator and Target columns, and a mor column with the sign of each interaction; see compute.TFs.activity()) from input/ARACNE/<cancer_type>/network/network.txt.

method

Character. The decoupleR statistic used to score the TFs and the PROGENy pathways: "ulm" (univariate linear model, default), "mlm" (multivariate linear model), "wsum" (weighted sum) or "consensus" (consensus of the three). Passed to compute.TFs.activity() and compute.pathway.activity().

min_targets_size

Integer. Minimum number of target genes per regulon, passed to compute.TFs.activity(). Default is 5.

universe

Optional. A user-specified data frame of TF-target interactions (columns source, target and mor, the mode of regulation: 1 activation, -1 repression). If not provided, the function will fetch the relevant network based on the TF.collection argument.

paths

Optional. A user-specified data frame of pathways gene sets. If not provided, the function will fetch the relevant pathways based on PROGENy.

gene_sets

Optional. A named list of custom gene sets (character vectors of gene symbols) passed to compute.pathway.activity()'s gene_sets argument for GSVA-based scoring. If NULL, only PROGENy is used.

min_module_size

Integer; minimum module size for WGCNA module detection. Default is 5.

corr_mod

Numeric; correlation threshold for merging TF modules. Default is 0.9.

soft_power

(Optional) Soft-thresholding power used to build the TF network, passed to compute.WTCNA(): one value, or one value per cohort (in the order the cohorts first appear in batch) in multi-cohort mode. If NULL (default), it is chosen automatically.

consensus_quantile

Numeric between 0 and 1, used in multi-cohort mode only: quantile of the topological overlaps of each pair of TFs across cohorts used as their consensus (0, the default, is the minimum: two TFs are close only if they are close in every cohort; higher values are less strict). Passed to compute.WTCNA().

clustering_method

Linkage method of the hierarchical clusterings (stats::hclust()): of the TFs, to build the TF modules (compute.WTCNA()), and of the deconvolution features of each TF module, to build the cell groups (construct_cell_groups()). Default is "ward.D2".

corr

Numeric; correlation threshold used in the deconvolution analysis. Default is 0.7.

corr_type

Correlation type used in every step that computes correlations: "spearman" (default) or "pearson". Passed to multideconv::compute.deconvolution.analysis() (deconvolution subgroups), compute.WTCNA() (TF network and module merging) and construct_cell_groups() (correlation between TF modules and deconvolution features).

cells_extra

(Optional) A character vector with the cell names to consider that are not included in the nomenclature of multideconv (see R package). This includes the group names created with multideconv::aggregate_cell_groups() on deconv (e.g. "Lymphocytes"): if they are not listed here they are discarded.

pval

Numeric; p-value threshold used when building cell groups (selection of the deconvolution features significantly correlated with each TF module). Default is 0.05.

padj

Logical; if TRUE, the p-values used when building cell groups are corrected for multiple testing (Benjamini-Hochberg, across the deconvolution features for each TF module) and compared with pval. Passed to construct_cell_groups(). Default is FALSE.

min_cluster_size

Integer; minimum number of features of a cell group (minimum cluster size of the dynamic tree cut), passed to construct_cell_groups(). Default is 3.

compute_factors

Logical. If TRUE (default), the NMF latent factors (compute.latent_factors()) and the cell niches (compute_cells_niches()) are computed from the cell group scores. If FALSE, they are skipped (Latent_spaces and Cells_niches are NULL), e.g. in the cross-validation folds of prepare_celltfusion_folds(), where only the cell group scores are used.

top_n

Integer. Number of top-contributing cell groups per NMF factor in the cell niches (see compute_cells_niches()). Default is 5.

cancer_type

Character. Cancer type abbreviation (e.g. "skcm"), only used when TF.collection = "ARACNE", to locate the ARACNe network at input/ARACNE/<cancer_type>/network/network.txt. If NULL, the network is auto-detected when only one exists under input/ARACNE/.

return

Logical; if TRUE, intermediate matrices and plots are written to the "Results/" folder. Default is TRUE.

verbose

Logical; whether to print the progress and the console output and messages of every step (warnings are always shown). Default is TRUE.

seed

Integer. Random seed of the pipeline (deconvolution methods with random steps and NMF), so that results are reproducible. Default is 123.

Value

A list containing:

Deconvolution

A matrix with cell-type proportions (samples as rows, cell types as columns); NULL if dt was supplied without deconv.

TFs_matrix

A matrix with TF activity scores (samples as rows, TFs as columns), or a list of matrices (one per cohort) when batch is given. Single cohort: raw scores (not scaled), which do not depend on the other samples (e.g. for machine learning features, to be scaled with the training samples). With batch: scores z-scored within each cohort (correction of cohort shifts).

TF_network

The TF module network returned by compute.WTCNA(). Its module matrix is always in the sample order of raw_counts (also in multi-cohort mode).

Pathways_scores

Pathway activity scores returned by compute.pathway.activity(): raw in single-cohort mode, z-scored within each cohort with batch (as TFs_matrix).

Processed_deconvolution

The processed deconvolution subgroups (output of multideconv::compute.deconvolution.analysis()).

Cell_groups

Output of construct_cell_groups(): cell group scores, compositions and projection weights.

Latent_spaces

NMF latent factors returned by compute.latent_factors() (NULL with compute_factors = FALSE).

Cells_niches

Top cell groups of each latent factor, with their deconvolution features and CCA coefficients (see compute_cells_niches(); NULL with compute_factors = FALSE).

Details

The pipeline runs with a fixed random seed (seed) so results are reproducible; the caller's random number generator state is restored when the function returns. With normalized = TRUE, sample names are converted with make.names() (e.g. "TCGA-XX-1234" becomes "TCGA.XX.1234"), as multideconv::compute.deconvolution() also does; deconv rows are matched to the samples in either form.

Examples


if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("raw.counts.tuto")

res <- CellTFusion(
  raw_counts = raw.counts.tuto,
  normalized = TRUE,
  deconv_methods = c("Quantiseq", "DeconRNASeq"),
  file_name = "TestRun",
  min_targets_size = 15,
  min_module_size = 20,
  corr_mod = 0.25,
  corr = 0.7,
  pval = 0.05
)

# Re-run with previously computed features, skipping straight to cell group construction
res2 <- CellTFusion(
  raw_counts = raw.counts.tuto,
  dt = res$Processed_deconvolution,
  tfs = res$TFs_matrix,
  pathways = res$Pathways_scores,
  normalized = TRUE,
  file_name = "TestRun_rerun",
  min_module_size = 20,
  corr_mod = 0.25,
  pval = 0.05
)
} # }
